name: Religare Enterprises Ltd
title: Religare Enterprises Ltd - 532915 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Holding-company call with no capacity or pricing data; Care GWP up 24% to INR11,417 crores and combined ratio 101.4%, but the demerger structure and promoter stake questions went unanswered.

triggers.label: Care GWP up 24% to INR11,417 crores
triggers.quote: The company delivered a top line of INR11,417 crores on a full premium basis, reflecting 24% growth while retail health grew by 34%.

triggers.label: Holding discount and stake questions unanswered
triggers.quote: We will evaluate all this. I mean, we will evaluate all this, and we'll get back to you.

guidance.quote: It should come down near 100% in 2 years' time line.
Range can be anything between 18% to 24%.
maybe give it another 12 to 18 months.

red_flags.label: Promoter stake below IRDA 26% norm
red_flags.quote: Upon conversion of outstanding warrants, this stake is expected to rise further.

red_flags.label: Litigation to recover fraudulently taken FD
red_flags.quote: it was an FD that was fraudulently taken away from RFL

evasions.topic: Holding company discount and demerger timeline
evasions.quote: we will keep this at the back of our minds, and we will see what we have to do at an appropriate stage.
Now whether we can increase our stake to 26%, that is speculative. Time will tell.
